items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: "I said, 'Louie, I want to see you just a minute.' Louie came to me and said, 'Yes, what do you want?'"

ctx.x: You couldn't afford a new horn.

Couldn't afford a new horn. But, yeah, see. So, when he told me I had to have a new horn, see, the boss was kicking on me. I went to the boss -- I'm thinking that the boss is kicking, I said -- and I switched it around turned the thing around when I went to the boss, see. I said, "Louie, I want to see you just a minute." Louie came to me and said, "Yes, what do you want?" I said, "My horn is playing me kind of bad and," I says, "what I'd like to do," I said, "I'd like for you to buy me a new horn and take it out…
